note: Curated classification of the pinned engine's slash-command registry. Every row captured from GET /v1/commands must appear in exactly one group or in `commands`. tools/build/slash-catalog.mjs refuses an unannotated row, an annotation naming a command the engine does not have, and an alias that collides.

defaults.sideEffects: The engine documentation for this command does not state whether it changes state; treat it as consequential until read.
defaults.routeNote: The pinned engine implements this command in its own terminal UI. Mona describes it here and does not run it; the terminal drawer is where the engine's own help applies.

groups.label: model work
groups.sideEffects: Sends a provider request: it spends tokens on the configured route. Some variants also change files (review, init, edit, restore-like undo).

groups.label: declared cost unknown
groups.sideEffects: May send a provider request depending on its arguments or an external service's response; the registry summary does not settle it, so Mona does not claim zero cost.

groups.label: local read
groups.sideEffects: Reads local session or engine state. No provider request and no file change.

groups.label: session or configuration change
groups.sideEffects: Changes session, window, or Codewhale configuration state. No provider request is made by the command itself.

groups.label: workspace rollback
groups.sideEffects: Changes files in the workspace: it rolls the working tree back to a recorded point. No provider request is made by the command itself.

compact.routeNote: Compaction is a provider request over this thread's context. Mona does not run it from the composer; it is handled by the terminal drawer or a later qualified route.

new.sideEffects: Starts a fresh engine conversation. History, drafts and usage records remain; no provider request is made until the new conversation is used.
new.routeNote: Mona starts the new conversation itself: the current session keeps its history, draft and usage, and the runtime opens a thread when the new conversation first sends work.

help.routeNote: Mona opens its own command catalog: every row comes from the engine's registry, and opening it makes no request.

exit.routeNote: Quitting the engine's terminal UI is not Mona's close action. Mona's own quit flow is the window's; this row explains the engine's spelling only.

fullscreen.routeNote: The engine's alternate terminal screen is not the desktop window's fullscreen state; W06 owns the native window operation.

inline.routeNote: The engine's inline/scrollback mode is a terminal concern; it has no desktop-window equivalent.

settings.routeNote: Mona has its own Settings section; the engine's settings surface stays available in the terminal drawer.

theme.routeNote: Mona applies its own appearance settings; the engine's theme applies to its terminal UI.

attach.sideEffects: Adds a media or file reference to the engine session. It does not send a request by itself.
attach.routeNote: Mona's own file references are project-relative text; the engine's media attachment is a different, terminal-side mechanism.
